metadata.name: BookOrbit
metadata.description: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It syncs progress and highlights across the web reader, Kobo, and KOReader, with metadata lookup, reading stats, OPDS, and multi-user OIDC support.
metadata.tagline: Your self-hosted reading space for books, audiobooks, and comics
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: APP_URL
environment_variables.description: Public URL used by emails and Kobo endpoints - replace [YOUR_CASAOS_LAN_IP] with your server IP (required)

environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL password - CHANGE THIS IN PRODUCTION (required)

environment_variables.name: JWT_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Secret used to sign login tokens - CHANGE THIS IN PRODUCTION (required)

environment_variables.name: SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: One-time token required to complete the setup wizard (required)

environment_variables.name: PUID
environment_variables.description: Runtime UID for files written to app data folders - match your books folder owner on NAS (optional)

environment_variables.name: PGID
environment_variables.description: Runtime GID for files written to app data folders - match your books folder owner on NAS (optional)

environment_variables.name: LIBRARY_BROWSE_ROOT
environment_variables.description: Container folder where the library picker starts instead of / (optional)

environment_variables.name: BOOK_DOCK_PATH
environment_variables.description: Container path for the automated ingestion drop folder (optional)

volumes.description: Book library folder - point this at your existing book files

before_install.en_us:
📚 BOOKORBIT SETUP

1. Place your book files in the ./books folder next to the compose file, or point the bind mount at an existing library path.
2. Update APP_URL to your server's actual address after install so Kobo sync and emails work.
3. After starting, open http://your-server-ip:3000 and complete setup using SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN from docker-compose.yml.

The app container runs read-only with dropped capabilities for security.

after_install.en_us: Access the web UI at http://your-server-ip:3000. Create libraries from your /books folder and add users in Settings.
